question: At 55 mph, what advance placement distances does Table 2C-3 show for Condition A and for a potential stop condition?
model_answer: Direct Answer: For a posted or 85th-percentile speed of 55 mph, Table 2C-3 shows an advance placement distance of 990 feet for Condition A (speed reduction and lane changing in heavy traffic). For a potential stop condition (the Condition B column headed "0," which per footnote 3 covers signs such as Stop Ahead, Yield Ahead, Signal Ahead, and Intersection Warning), the table shows 495 feet. Standards (mandatory): - "The Stop Ahead (W3-1), Yield Ahead (W3-2), and Signal Ahead (W3-3) Advance Traffic Control signs (see Figure 2C-8) shall be installed on an approach to a primary traffic control device that is not visible for a sufficient distance to permit the road user to respond to the device (see Table 2C-3)." - "The Yield Ahead or Stop Ahead sign shall be located in accordance with Table 2C-3. The minimum distance between the signs shall be in accordance with Section 2C.04 and Table 2C-3." Guidance (recommended): - Warning signs should be placed to provide an adequate PRT, with the distances in Table 2C-3 applied with engineering judgment; "The effectiveness of the placement of warning signs should be periodically evaluated under both day and night conditions." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Table 2C-3 shows, for the 55 mph row, 990 ft under Condition A and 495 ft under the Condition B "0³" column, with footnote 3 identifying that column as the potential stop condition (typical signs: Stop Ahead, Yield Ahead, Signal Ahead, and Intersection Warning) based on 2018 AASHTO stopping sight distance with a 2.5-second PRT and 11.2 ft/s² deceleration. - [Image 2] Page 193 (Section 2C.04) presents the same Table 2C-3 confirming the 55 mph values of 990 ft (Condition A) and 495 ft (potential stop, 0 column). - [Image 3] Page 1042 (Section 8B.06) requires Grade Crossing Advance Warning and Stop/Yield Ahead sign placement to follow Section 2C.04 and Table 2C-3, but shows no 55 mph values itself. - [Image 4] Page 211 does not contain the 55 mph placement distances; it addresses other warning signs (e.g., NARROW BRIDGE, ONE LANE BRIDGE) that reference Table 2C-3 Condition A. - [Image 5] Page 695 addresses traffic signal warrants and does not bear on the 55 mph placement distances. Citations: - Table 2C-3 (p.152) - Section 2C.04 Guidance §5 (p.152) - Section 2C.35 Standard §1 (p.177) - Section 8B.06 Standard §3 (p.1001) - Page 193
gold_answer: 990 feet for Condition A and 495 feet for the potential stop condition.
